Paper accepted for VISSOFT 2011

A paper by Martin Beck, Jonas Trümper, and Jürgen Döllner entitled "A Visual Analysis and Design Tool for Planning Software Reengineerings" has been accepted for VISSOFT 2011, which is held in Williamsburg, Virginia on September 29-30, 2011.
